profile.headline: Software Engineer at ShipMoney
profile.summary: I have a passion for the computer and technology fields. Especially in software, which I was trained in colleges and workplaces. I have 10+ years working as a full-time software engineer. I am a strong self-motivative, self-regulated, problem-resolver, easy to adapt to new environments, and willing to learn new things. People also tell me that I am humorous, honest, humble, and kind. I also care about people and want to make them happy, because, in that way, it makes me happy as well.
